name: DPP record model v1: a passport chain, its links, and the owner-signed transfer

vectors.description: Genesis: ACTIVATE by the maker, locked to the maker. Sign the twelve data fields as actor and as service, then build the fourteen-field script and the one-output transaction (spec record-model.md sections 2, 5 and 6).
SOLD by the maker, spending the genesis output. The DPP output sits at index 1 behind an OP_RETURN, so a reader tracks the outpoint rather than assuming index 0. Ownership does not move on SOLD.

TRANSFER to the second owner, signed by the first owner. Field 7 equals the previous field 6, which is the equality form of the owner-signed transfer (spec custody.md section 4) although nothing in the first four states depends on the option.
REPAIRED by the second owner: event_data carries the operation metadata, payload and owner unchanged.

TRANSFER by the second owner to the third owner's per-passport owner key, derived from the third owner's root under [1, 'dpp owner v1'] with the passport identifier as key identifier and counterparty self (spec record-model.md section 3). The output is locked to that same key: the possession convention (spec custody.md section 3). Field 7 equals the previous field 6: the equality form of consent.

TRANSFER by the third owner, acting under their root, to the first owner's per-passport owner key, again locked to it. event_data carries owner_linkage, the BRC-69 specific key linkage such that the previous field 6 equals field 7 plus owner_linkage times G: the linkage form of consent. The input is spent by the third owner's wallet through the PushDrop unlock under the owner protocol, one derivation and no key export; RFC 6979 nonces make the unlocking script reproducible.

The third owner's per-passport owner key and its linkage scalar (spec record-model.md section 3, spec custody.md sections 2 and 4). The key is the root derived under the owner protocol with the passport identifier as key identifier and counterparty self; the scalar is the BRC-42 HMAC for that derivation, which only the root can compute, and owner_key = root_public_key + linkage times G, which anyone can check.
The first owner's per-passport owner key, the field 6 the sixth state transfers to, from the same derivation.

Verify the six raw transactions as a chain, genesis to tip, with the owner-signed transfer selected and no header source: every user signature verifies, every link holds, every server signature verifies under the service key, inclusion is pending, and the owner-signed transfer holds on the three TRANSFER states and is not applicable elsewhere (null). Scripts are not run by the verifier; the network ran them.
A lone state whose operation is SOLD. Invariant 2: the genesis operation is ACTIVATE.

expected.reason: genesis op must be ACTIVATE, got SOLD

vectors.description: An ACTIVATE state whose field 12 is set. Invariant 2: genesis carries no previous_txid.
The genesis transaction with its DPP output duplicated. Invariant 1: exactly one DPP output per transaction.

expected.reason: exactly one DPP output required, found 2

vectors.description: A second ACTIVATE spending the genesis output. Invariant 3: ACTIVATE at any later position fails the link.

expected.reason: ACTIVATE is allowed at genesis only

vectors.description: Spends the genesis output but field 12 names a different transaction. Invariant 4: previous_txid must equal the spent tip txid.

expected.reason: previous_txid must equal the spent tip txid

vectors.description: Field 12 names the genesis correctly but the input spends a different output of it. Invariant 4: the spend is checked structurally, not only on the readable field.

expected.reason: state does not spend the previous tip output

vectors.description: A SOLD state naming a different passport_id. Invariant 5: passport_id never changes.

expected.reason: passport_id is immutable across the chain

vectors.description: A REPAIRED state that also changes owner_identity_key. Invariant 6: the owner changes only on TRANSFER.
A SOLD state carrying a changed payload_public. Invariant 7: payloads change only on ACTIVATE, EDIT or TRANSFER.

expected.reason: payload_public / payload_owner_hash change only on ACTIVATE, EDIT or TRANSFER

vectors.description: A TRANSFER spending state 5 (owner: owner 3's derived key) made by owner 2, who no longer owns it, with empty event_data. Under the owner-signed transfer neither equality nor linkage holds; without the option the state is a valid TRANSFER, which is the whole reason the option exists.

expected.reason: TRANSFER actor is not the previous owner and event_data carries no owner_linkage

vectors.description: A TRANSFER spending state 4 (owner: owner 2's identity key) made by owner 1, the previous owner, with no linkage. The equality form compares against the previous state's owner, never an earlier one.

expected.reason: TRANSFER actor is not the previous owner and event_data carries no owner_linkage

vectors.description: Owner 3 acting under the right root, but event_data carries owner 2's scalar for this passport: well-formed, and reaching a different key. Refused at the point addition.

expected.reason: owner_linkage does not link actor_identity_key to the previous owner_identity_key

vectors.description: The correct scalar spelled in upper-case hex. One value has one spelling; refused before any arithmetic.

expected.reason: owner_linkage must be 64 lower-case hex characters

vectors.description: The correct scalar missing its last character: 63 hex characters. Refused as malformed, not tried as a number.

expected.reason: owner_linkage must be 64 lower-case hex characters

vectors.description: event_data is a JSON array holding the correct scalar. Valid JSON, not an object, so there is no owner_linkage property to read.

expected.reason: TRANSFER actor is not the previous owner and event_data carries no owner_linkage

vectors.description: A TRANSFER spending state 6 made by the maker, with a stated reason and no proof of consent. Refused under the option alone; accepted when the maker is a configured transfer authority (acceptedUnder), which is what a recovery looks like.

expected.reason: TRANSFER actor is not the previous owner and event_data carries no owner_linkage
